The package downloads a pinned .deb from official GitHub releases with SHA-256 verification, and the package() function uses standard tools (ar, tar) to extract it. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is not substantive - it's caused by Report 1 (qwen) failing with an HTTP 400 API error during the full PKGBUILD review. coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen): PKGBUILD full review failed due to API error (HTTP 400, BadRequestError), resulting in inconclusive verdict
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient API errors to prevent incomplete reviews
For binary packages (-bin), ensure the review explicitly covers the package() function's artifact handling, not just global scope safety
When one model fails due to tool errors, weight the successful model's detailed analysis more heavily in the final verdict
